positions.name: AsyncJobContractTerms
positions.frame: what does the ratified async job contract commit remember to — immediate receipt, non-blocking dispatch, and how the extraction's completion is later discovered?
positions.why: All three expressions read in the same direction: a settled, ratified contract (src-1 announces ratification and states the receipt/cursor terms; src-2 asserts the guarantees that follow — no blocking, no lost work; src-3 restates the dispatch as a 'key decision' and specifies the two retrieval paths). The register and conviction reads reinforce this as one coherent, native-vocabulary statement of a settled decision rather than three separate claims — decision language ('ratified', 'Key decision') and technical vocabulary (receipt, cursor, dispatch, poll, piggyback) run unbroken across all three, so they cohere as a single group rather than staying isolated.
